title: Position-Dependent Activation and Repression by As(III) in an Engineered BetI Transcriptional Repressor.
authors: Kamiya, Katsumasa; Yamaguchi, Ryo; Shimizu, Kojiro; Kawai-Noma, Shigeko
one_liner_zh: 该文通过分子动力学模拟探究工程化BetI转录抑制因子中As(III)响应与DNA结合域构象变化的关系，虽未直接测量TF-DNA结合，但涉及转录因子调控与MD模拟，对TF-DNA互作机制建模有方法学参考价值。
abstract: Arsenite [As-(III)]-responsive transcriptional regulation is widely employed by microorganisms for detoxification and homeostasis. Engineering As-(III)-responsive behavior into transcription factors that are intrinsically metal-insensitive remains challenging. Here, we introduced a third cysteine residue at different positions in the engineered BetI(L79C/Q81C) scaffold and evaluated the resulting whole-cell sfGFP reporter responses. The magnitude and direction of the As-(III)-dependent reporter change varied with the position of the introduced cysteine. Under combined As-(III) and choline inputs, selected variants exhibited operational OR-like or As-(III)-inhibited reporter-output patterns over defined concentration ranges. To explore possible structural interpretations for these reporter phenotypes, we performed molecular dynamics simulations using predefined dithiol- and trithiol-coordination models. Simulations of these models yielded distinct fluctuation patterns in the DNA-binding domain, providing testable structural hypotheses for the observed reporter phenotypes. Because neither As-(III) binding to the engineered cysteine sites nor As-(III)-dependent changes in BetI-DNA binding were directly measured, the reporter assays and simulations do not establish the underlying molecular mechanism. Nevertheless, our experiments show that cysteine placement can tune the direction of As-(III)-dependent whole-cell sfGFP output in an engineered BetI regulatory system and thereby expand the design space for multi-input transcriptional devices.
abstract_zh: 亚砷酸盐 [As-(III)] 响应性转录调控被微生物广泛用于解毒和稳态维持。将As-(III)响应行为工程化到本质上对金属不敏感的转录因子中仍具挑战性。在此，我们在工程化BetI(L79C/Q81C)支架的不同位置引入了第三个半胱氨酸残基，并评估了所得全细胞sfGFP报告基因的响应。As-(III)依赖性报告基因变化的幅度和方向随引入半胱氨酸的位置而异。在As-(III)和胆碱联合输入下，选定变体在特定浓度范围内表现出可操作的OR样或As-(III)抑制的报告基因输出模式。为探索这些报告基因表型的可能结构解释，我们使用预定义的双硫醇和三硫醇配位模型进行了分子动力学模拟。这些模型的模拟在DNA结合域中产生了不同的波动模式，为观察到的报告基因表型提供了可测试的结构假设。由于As-(III)与工程化半胱氨酸位点的结合以及As-(III)依赖性BetI-DNA结合变化均未直接测量，报告基因检测和模拟并未确立潜在的分子机制。尽管如此，我们的实验表明，半胱氨酸的定位可调节工程化BetI调控系统中As-(III)依赖性全细胞sfGFP输出的方向，从而扩展了多输入转录装置的设计空间。
